releaseNotes: Added in-progress permit routing for Arizona, Louisiana, Arkansas, and Oklahoma using state permit data and public state GIS sources.
Added all 50 state pilot-car profiles covering escort triggers, sign and banner placement, flags, safety equipment, and certification guidance.
Added monitored official state-rule sources, reviewed-package validation, offline caching, and immutable state-rule snapshots in trip audit records.
Added Android PDF permit import so a permit can be opened directly from email, downloads, or a document provider.
Improved permit OCR, QR recovery, route mileage parsing, ramp and frontage-road handling, detours, and disconnected-route safeguards.
Improved navigation with navigation-audio voice guidance, a live speed display, map-lock controls, larger instructions, and a light-map default.
Refreshed the Android launcher and splash branding and kept the status and navigation bars persistently available.
Improved app sharing with the public install page, native email and share-sheet support, and a text-message composer that prefills the message and install link.
